mapper.sql: select c.customer_id, c.customer_code, c.customer_name, c.contact_person, c.contact_phone, c.contact_email, c.address, c.credit_limit, c.payment_method, c.customer_level, c.status, c.del_flag, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark from md_customer c left join sys_user su on su.user_name = c.create_by
mapper.insert:
insert into md_customer
customer_code, customer_name, contact_person, contact_phone, contact_email, address, credit_limit, payment_method, customer_level, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, remark,
#{customerCode}, #{customerName}, #{contactPerson}, #{contactPhone}, #{contactEmail}, #{address}, #{creditLimit}, #{paymentMethod}, #{customerLevel}, #{status}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{updateBy}, #{remark},
mapper.select: select (select count(1) from crm_customer_follow where customer_id = #{customerId}) + (select count(1) from md_customer_price where customer_id = #{customerId}) + (select count(1) from fin_invoice where invoice_direction = 'sale' and target_id = #{customerId}) + (select count(1) from wms_sale_order where customer_id = #{customerId}) + (select count(1) from wms_sale_return where customer_id = #{customerId}) + (select count(1) from wms_outbound where customer_id = #{customerId}) + (select count(1) from fin_receivable where customer_id = #{customerId}) + (select count(1) from fin_receipt where customer_id = #{customerId})
mapper.delete:
delete from md_customer where customer_id in
#{customerId}
mapper.select: select count(1) as totalOrderCount, ifnull(sum(case when status = 'audited' then total_amount else 0 end), 0) as totalSaleAmount, ifnull(sum(case when status = 'audited' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as auditedOrderCount, max(create_time) as lastOrderTime from wms_sale_order where customer_id = #{customerId} and status not in ('rejected', 'cancelled')

select ifnull(sum(ifnull(fr.amount_due, 0)), 0) as totalReceivableAmount, ifnull(sum(ifnull(fr.amount_paid, 0)), 0) as totalReceivedAmount, ifnull(sum(greatest(ifnull(fr.amount_due, 0) - ifnull(fr.amount_paid, 0), 0)), 0) as remainReceivableAmount, ifnull(sum(case when fr.status in ('unpaid', 'partial') and fr.due_date is not null and fr.due_date < curdate() then greatest(ifnull(fr.amount_due, 0) - ifnull(fr.amount_paid, 0), 0) else 0 end), 0) as overdueAmount, ifnull(sum(case when fr.status in ('unpaid', 'partial') and fr.due_date is not null and fr.due_date < curdate() and ifnull(fr.amount_due, 0) - ifnull(fr.amount_paid, 0) > 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as overdueCount from fin_receivable fr left join wms_sale_order so on so.sale_order_id = fr.sale_order_id where coalesce(fr.customer_id, so.customer_id) = #{customerId}

select sale_order_id as saleOrderId, order_no as orderNo, ifnull(total_qty, 0) as totalQty, ifnull(total_amount, 0) as totalAmount, status, payment_status as paymentStatus, create_time as createTime from wms_sale_order where customer_id = #{customerId} order by sale_order_id desc limit 5

select follow_id as followId, follow_type as followType, follow_time as followTime, follow_content as followContent, next_follow_time as nextFollowTime, status from crm_customer_follow where customer_id = #{customerId} order by follow_time desc, follow_id desc limit 5

select soi.product_id as productId, mp.product_code as productCode, ifnull(mp.product_name, concat('商品#', soi.product_id)) as productName, ifnull(sum(soi.quantity), 0) as totalQty, ifnull(sum(soi.amount), 0) as totalAmount from wms_sale_order_item soi join wms_sale_order so on so.sale_order_id = soi.sale_order_id left join md_product mp on mp.product_id = soi.product_id where so.customer_id = #{customerId} and so.status = 'audited' group by soi.product_id, mp.product_code, mp.product_name order by totalAmount desc limit 5
